title: 第8章 是不是就喜欢这种偷感
slug: 酒店亲错人京圈大佬他白天嫌弃晚上疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

温以染一僵，猛地想起陆景琛打电话的时候，傅临渊正趴在她耳朵旁边。

无不无聊？又要截胡。

不过她无所谓，两个男人，两份钱，不亏。

傅临渊“嗯”了一色，目光淡淡扫过温以染，最后才落在陆景琛身上，“跟朋友谈点事，看到你过来打个招呼。”

他身后的男人一双桃花眼，笑嘻嘻地打招呼，“陆少，不介绍一下这位是......”

陆景琛揽住温以染的肩，“我女朋友，温以染。”

“既然遇到了，别在这吃了，没意思”，傅临渊语气不容商量，“去鎏金台，延之攒的局，一起。”

谢延之附和：“对呀陆少，一起呗，赏个脸。”

陆景琛哪敢拒绝傅临渊，立刻点头，“行，一起。”

谢延之看向温以染，她笑得温顺，“我听陆少的，好呀。”

到了鎏金台，整整一层楼是高档一体化私密娱乐区。

陆景琛和谢延之开了一桌斯诺克。

傅临渊站在美式球台边，慢条斯理地挑球杆，“温小姐会打球吗？”

温以染还没回答，陆景琛在不远处喊：“宝贝，陪傅总玩两把。”

“好呀，陆少”，温以染朝傅临渊走过去。

傅临渊站在她身后，胸膛贴着她的背，左手覆上她的手背，带着她握杆。

“腰要沉下去。”

温以染照做，刚俯身，他的右手就顺势滑到她的腰侧，探进薄薄的衣料，摸到她腰窝那块疤痕位置。

她手一抖，差点脱杆。

“别抖。”他贴着她的耳朵，只有她能听见，“自然点。”

球杆推出，白球撞击红球，滑入袋中。

“不错”，傅临渊夸奖，手却得寸进尺，在她臀部捏了一把，力道大的她差点叫出来。

温以染猛地直起身，回头瞪他。

傅临渊神色不变，看向不远处的陆景琛，“景琛，你这女朋友，身体协调性很差。”

陆景琛哈哈笑：“她哪会这个，傅总多教教。”

“嗯”，傅临渊再次俯身贴上去，这次更过分，直接膝盖顶进她的腿间，从背后环住她，双手握住球杆。

他的唇擦着她耳尖，只有她能听到：“他知道你这么软吗？”

“知道你被按在身下叫得多好听吗？”

Page (1/3)

Wen Yiran froze and suddenly remembered that Fu Linyuan was lying next to her ear when Lu Jingchen called.

All boring?Cutting off the beard again.

But she doesn't care, two men, two pieces of money, no loss.

Fu Linyuan said "hmm", his eyes swept over Wen Yiran, and finally fell on Lu Jingchen, "I'm talking to a friend about something. I saw you coming over to say hello."

The man behind him had peach blossom eyes and greeted him with a smile, "Master Lu, if I don't introduce you, who is this..."

Lu Jingchen put his arm around Wen Yiran's shoulders, "My girlfriend, Wen Yiran."

"Now that we have met, don't eat here, it's boring." Fu Linyuan said in a tone that did not allow for negotiation. "Go to the Gilding Platform and continue the game together."

Xie Yanzhi echoed: "Yes, Mr. Lu, let's come together and show your face."

How dare Lu Jingchen refuse Fu Linyuan, he immediately nodded, "Okay, let's go together."

Xie Yanzhi looked at Wen Yiran, and she smiled meekly, "I'll listen to Mr. Lu, okay."

Arriving at Gilt Terrace, the entire floor is a high-end integrated private entertainment area.

Lu Jingchen and Xie Yanzhi played a table of snooker.

Fu Linyuan stood by the American table and picked the cue slowly, "Can Miss Wen know how to play?"

Before Wen Yiran could answer, Lu Jingchen called from not far away: "Baby, play a few games with Mr. Fu."

"Okay, Mr. Lu", Wen Yiran walked towards Fu Linyuan.

Fu Linyuan stood behind her, his chest pressed against her back, his left hand covering the back of her hand, leading her to hold the pole.

"The waist is going to sink."

Wen Yiran did as he was told. As soon as he leaned over, his right hand slid to her waist, penetrated the thin material of her clothes, and touched the scar on her waist.

Her hand shook and she almost fell off the pole.

"Don't shake." He pressed against her ear so that only she could hear, "Be natural."

The club is pushed out and the white ball hits the red ball and slides into the pocket.

"Not bad," Fu Linyuan praised, but his hand went even further and pinched her buttocks so hard that she almost screamed.

Wen Yiran straightened up suddenly and turned to glare at him.

Fu Linyuan's expression remained unchanged and he looked at Lu Jingchen not far away, "Jingchen, your girlfriend has poor physical coordination."

Lu Jingchen laughed: "How can she know this? Mr. Fu needs to teach her more."

"Yeah." Fu Linyuan leaned forward again, this time going even further. He pushed his knee directly between her legs, hugged her from behind, and held the club with both hands.

His lips rubbed the tip of her ear, and only she could hear: "Does he know you are so soft?"

"Do you know how nice it sounds when you are held down and screamed?"
